info.name: Zitadel Mock API v2.65.1
info.description:
Test collection for the mock Zitadel service. Base URL defaults to http://localhost:8118. In docker-compose, the service is reachable at http://zitadel-api:8118.

Two things shape this API. First, the **organization is a header**: `x-zitadel-orgid` selects it for the whole request, and absent it the instance default (Orbit Labs) is used. A user in one org is simply not found from another, and a token minted for one org cannot administer another.

Second, **sessions are built up factor by factor**. There is no login call. `POST /v2/sessions` records a factor for each `check` that passes -- user, password, webAuthN, totp -- and `PATCH` adds more as the user completes them. Every update rotates the session token. The org's login policy is enforced at the *end*, when a session is exchanged for an OIDC callback: orbit-labs sets `forceMfa`, so a password-only session is refused there and the identical request succeeds in the partner org.

Tokens: `zt-pat-instance-admin-5b07d21f8c64` (IAM_OWNER, any org), `zt-pat-orbit-ci-9f14c73e0b2a` (orbit-labs, may write), `zt-pat-readonly-c8e05a1976b3` (orbit-labs, read only), `zt-pat-partners-2d47b9e01f5c` (partner org), `zt-pat-revoked-1e94c7a305df` (revoked). Every write returns a `details` envelope with a monotonic `sequence`. Requests labelled '(N expected)' assert an error path.
